e.title: AI Insurance Multi-Agent (MCP)
e.summary: 企业级保险多智能体系统 + MCP 集成：理赔处理/欺诈检测等智能体微服务
e.body: AI-Insurance-MultiAgent-MCP（balajircs83）是企业级保险管理系统：多个 AI 智能体（理赔处理 ML 评分、欺诈检测风险评估等）以微服务部署，MCP（Model Context Protocol）服务器集成，附前端 UI 与启动脚本。对 RIAA：MCP × 保险智能体的完整工程样例——「智能体即服务」的微服务架构（同 [[insurance-support-agent]] 的主管-专家、[[claims-intake-agent]] 的受理谱系）；与 [[governance-mcp]]（治理 MCP）对照理解 MCP 生态；企业级系统设计（React + API + MCP Server）是实习/毕业设计的架构参考。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：README 确认（多智能体 + MCP 集成 + 前端/API），未实测
e.summary_en: Enterprise insurance multi-agent system with MCP integration: claim-processing/fraud-detection agent microservices
e.summary_hk: 企業級保險多智能體系統 + MCP 集成：理賠處理/欺詐檢測等智能體微服務
e.body_en: AI-Insurance-MultiAgent-MCP (balajircs83) is an enterprise-grade insurance management system: multiple AI agents (claim processing with ML scoring, fraud detection with risk assessment and more) deployed as microservices, with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration, a frontend UI and startup scripts. For RIAA: a complete engineering example of MCP × insurance agents — the agent-as-a-service microservice architecture (sharing the supervisor-specialist pattern of [[insurance-support-agent]] and the claims-intake lineage of [[claims-intake-agent]]); compare with [[governance-mcp]] (governance MCP) to understand the MCP ecosystem; the enterprise system design (React + API + MCP Server) is an architecture reference for internships and final-year projects.
e.body_hk: AI-Insurance-MultiAgent-MCP（balajircs83）是企業級保險管理系統：多個 AI 智能體（理賠處理 ML 評分、欺詐檢測風險評估等）以微服務部署，MCP（Model Context Protocol）伺服器集成，附前端 UI 與啓動腳本。對 RIAA：MCP × 保險智能體的完整工程樣例——「智能體即服務」的微服務架構（同 [[insurance-support-agent]] 的主管-專家、[[claims-intake-agent]] 的受理譜系）；與 [[governance-mcp]]（治理 MCP）對照理解 MCP 生態；企業級系統設計（React + API + MCP Server）是實習/畢業設計的架構參考。
